# GP15-held-proof:1 producer corpus

These JSON documents were generated by GigPies' actual `HostAuthority` fixture
producer, not authored as Desk expectations. They include full unheld baselines
for independent digest computation, exact requests, 16/32/48-input proofs,
held/renewal observations, protected FOH behavior and explicit refusals.

Regenerate in GigPies under its parent-held build lock with Rust 1.97.1,
`CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 GIGPIES_UPDATE_HELD_PROOF_FIXTURES=1`
and `cargo +1.97.1 test --locked -j1 --features hardware-host --lib
held_proof_actual_authority_fixtures_and_refusals`. Copy the resulting JSON unchanged.
Desk's normal `held_proof::tests` decode this corpus and recompute each baseline
digest. Missing producer files fail the tests; they are never silently skipped.
